certImport.success: Certificate saved and paths filled in above.

guidedEditor.requiredFields: File name and server_name are required.
guidedEditor.sslDescription: Enables HTTPS for this site by referencing a certificate and key already present on the server.
guidedEditor.certMissing: File not found at this location.
guidedEditor.certNameMismatch: The imported certificate was tied to the name "{{oldName}}" — re-import it for "{{newName}}" before saving.
guidedEditor.certNamePrompt: Fill in the file name above to be able to import a certificate.
guidedEditor.maxBodySizeDescription: Limits the size of files/forms sent by visitors (e.g. 20m for 20 MB). Leave empty to keep Nginx's default (1 MB).

headers.frameOptions: Prevents the site from being displayed in an iframe on another domain (anti-clickjacking).
headers.contentTypeOptions: Prevents the browser from guessing a file's type differently from what the server declares.
headers.referrerPolicy: Limits the information sent to other sites when a visitor clicks an outbound link.
headers.hsts: Forces browsers to always use HTTPS for this site. Only enable if SSL is properly configured.
headers.xssProtection: Legacy browser protection against reflected XSS attacks (deprecated but still accepted).
headers.permissionsPolicy: Disables access to the camera, microphone, geolocation, etc. for this site.
headers.contentSecurityPolicy: Restricts allowed script/style sources (advanced XSS protection). Generic baseline value — adjust if the site loads external resources (fonts, CDN, etc.).

guidedEditor.tlsAdvancedDescription: Optional settings to harden/align the TLS configuration. Leave empty to keep Nginx's defaults. Values are usually pasted from an external generator (e.g. Mozilla SSL Config Generator).
guidedEditor.gzipDescription: Compresses responses before sending to speed up loading (text, CSS, JS, JSON...).
guidedEditor.presetsDescription: Common ready-to-use templates — no free text entry, to avoid a syntax error in a location block.

presets.blockDotfilesDescription: Denies direct access to sensitive files/folders starting with a dot.
presets.cacheStaticDescription: One-year browser cache for versioned static files (JS/CSS with a hash in the name, generated by Vite/Webpack).
presets.spaFallbackDescription: All unknown routes return index.html — required for a single-page app with client-side routing.

guidedEditor.serviceModeDescription: "Static files" serves a server folder directly; "Proxy" forwards requests to another address (e.g. a Node.js/Docker app on a local port).
